title: Batch neutralization pH-window dosing with out-of-range trip
nl_spec: An effluent tank is neutralized to a pH window by dosing acid or base. pH is supplied as a scaled integer (pH x 10), so pH = 70 means 7.0. The target window is PH_LOW = 65 to PH_HIGH = 75 (6.5 to 7.5). When pH is above the window (pH > PH_HIGH) the AcidValve doses acid to lower it; when pH is below the window (pH < PH_LOW) the BaseValve doses base to raise it; inside the window neither valve doses. To avoid a concentrated dose without mixing, dosing is permitted only while the Agitator is running. If pH is outside the safe measurement band (pH < PH_MIN_SAFE = 20 or pH > PH_MAX_SAFE = 120) the reading is treated as a sensor/over-range fault: raise OutOfRange and stop all dosing (manual intervention required). (The 2.0-12.0 safe auto-dosing band, PH_MIN_SAFE/PH_MAX_SAFE, is a plant policy choice for when automatic dosing is trusted, not a limitation of the pH probe itself.) The station runs only while Enable is TRUE. EStop is normally-closed (TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated); when activated all dosing stops. Acid and base must never dose at the same time. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named ph_dosing with inputs pH, Agitator, Enable, EStop and outputs AcidValve, BaseValve, OutOfRange.

interface.name: EStop
interface.description: Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated

interface.name: OutOfRange
interface.description: pH out of safe measurement band

safety_properties.nl: On emergency stop, neither dosing valve is open.
Acid and base never dose at the same time.
Dosing occurs only while the agitator is running.
Acid doses only when pH is above the target window.
Positive obligation: while healthy, enabled, agitating, in the safe band and below the window, base doses.
safety_properties.ltl: G((EStop & Enable & Agitator & pH >= 20 & pH <= 120 & pH < 65) -> BaseValve)

safety_properties.nl: When the pH reading is outside the safe measurement band, neither dosing valve is open.
When the station is disabled (Enable = FALSE), neither dosing valve is open.

scenarios.description: High pH doses acid; over-range stops dosing
In-window, no mixing, and E-stop all inhibit dosing
Disable inhibits all dosing even with pH below the window

notes: DRAFT - pending expert PLC review. NEW FAMILY: three-region window control on a scaled-INT process variable (below / inside / above the target band) with a dosing interlock and an out-of-safe-band fault. Distinct from hysteresis (no latched deadband memory - the region is a pure function of the current reading) and from two-output mutual exclusion (mutex is a secondary property; the primary structure is the three-region window plus the over-range fault). Exercises INT arithmetic comparisons in the verifier.
